blocks.text: Physical Branch Devices enable Zero Trust connectivity everywhere for all unauthenticated users, devices, servers, and IoT/OT, regardless of location. Additionally, they eliminate the attack surface by connecting branches and data centers through the Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE) independent of the underlying WAN transport network.
Physical Branch Devices provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Explore plug-and-play deployment, allowing zero touch provisioning to simplify deployment and reduce the time to integrate.
Prevent lateral threat movement, allowing Zero Trust connectivity to build a foundation for secure connectivity that enables east-to-west segmentation.

blocks.heading: About the Physical Branch Devices Page

blocks.text: On the Physical Branch Devices page (Infrastructure > Branch Connector > Appliances Group), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Search for a physical branch device.
View a list of physical branch devices. For each device, you can view:
Name: The name of the physical branch device.
Branch Type: The hardware device type of the physical branch device.
Serial Number: The serial number of the physical branch device.
Location: The location of the physical branch device.
Upgrade Window: The upgrade window for the physical branch device.
Operational Status: The operational status of the physical branch device (i.e., Inactive or Active).
HA Status: The High Availability (HA) status of the physical branch device (i.e., Disabled or Enabled).
Upgrade Status: The upgrade status of the physical branch device.
Modify the table and its columns.
View more information about the physical branch device.
Edit a physical branch device. To learn more, see Editing Physical Branch Devices.
View the Virtual Branch Devices page.
